rules: This manifest permits neither direct database writes nor automatic Cloudinary uploads.
Every sourceUrl is a direct image URL verified HTTP 200 with an image/* content-type on 2026-10-22; re-verify before upload.

assets.rightsBasis: Official NCE header logo served from the college's own WordPress uploads (full-size original of the Nellai-1024x309.png header image on https://nce.ac.in/). No open licence - official institutional brand mark used only to identify the college. Checked 2026-10-22: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 41,863 bytes, 1264x382 px, RGBA with transparent background. Visual check composited on a white tile: circular crest (orange laurel, orbit rings, lamp, 'Nellai College of Engineering' ring text and the line 'Taking you to tomorrow's technology'), dark-grey NELLAI wordmark and orange COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING - fully legible on white. Wide lockup; crop to the crest (left ~240 px) if a square mark is needed. Rejected: favicon-300x300.png (favicon).

HOLD - no rights-safe, non-misleading campus cover found. Official candidates reviewed 2026-10-22: (1) https://nce.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/NCE-College.jpg (1920x1080, HTTP 200 image/jpeg) shows the real arched academic block but is a digital composite: the foreground synthetic running track (mirrored lane numbers), hurdle, goalposts and tent are pasted in, with a visible blend seam at the right; publishing it would imply facilities NCE does not document. A crop to the building band (roughly y 150-560) removes most of the composite but still leaves seams and a 4:1 strip - reviewer may approve with a transformation crop, not recommended.
